name: Make It Scary!

pick.label: Pick a nightmare
pick.heading: Pick something ordinary and make it a horror film
lead: The best horror films take something completely normal, a hotel, a phone call, a weekend with your partner’s parents, and make it terrifying. One good poster is enough to give people nightmares before they have even seen the film.
Choose something from everyday life and turn it into a horror film. Here are some ideas, but you can choose your own. *Your job is the poster, not the film.*
pick.hint: Or click one to choose it.
pick.note: Nobody is going to make this film (probably). This is just for a bit of fun. Some ideas are genuinely scary, and some are only scary if you live in Berlin. Both are welcome.

rows: What ordinary thing is your horror film about?
Short, dark and easy to remember.
One line on the poster that makes people nervous.
The one image people see. What is it, and where is it?
The moment that makes the whole cinema scream.
Where do people see it first? A U-Bahn station, a billboard, a phone screen…

values.title: NO APPOINTMENTS
values.tagline: The next free date is in March. Nobody knows which year.
values.image: An empty waiting room, lit by one flickering screen that shows your number: 666.
values.scene: You finally get to the desk after four hours, and the man asks for a form you have never heard of. Then the lights go out.
values.where: Inside the Bürgeramt itself, so people see it while they wait. They will have plenty of time.

yours.label: Your film
yours.heading: Your poster
yours.lead: Fill it in on your own phone or laptop (it stays on your device), and be ready to tell the class about your film in a few sentences.

rank.label: The ranking
rank.heading: Which film would you queue for?
rank.lead: Each student tells us about their film in a few sentences. Add it, then argue it into place until everybody agrees.
